mean: to be originally from; to come from
ex: Mes grands-parents sont originaires d'un petit village de Bretagne.
exEn: My grandparents are originally from a small village in Brittany.

ex: Après la naissance de leur fils, ils se sont installés à la campagne.
exEn: After their son was born, they settled in the countryside.

mean: a path, a background (life, studies, career)
ex: Pendant l'entretien, on m'a demandé de résumer mon parcours.
exEn: During the interview, they asked me to sum up my background.

ex: Le médecin a fait une petite blague pour me mettre à l'aise.
exEn: The doctor made a little joke to put me at ease.

mean: to have a soft spot for
ex: Mon grand-père a toujours eu un faible pour les tartes aux pommes.
exEn: My grandfather has always had a soft spot for apple tarts.

mean: to develop a taste for; to start enjoying
ex: Avec ce club, j'ai pris goût à la course à pied.
exEn: With this club, I've developed a taste for running.

mean: to be passionate about; to be fascinated by
ex: Depuis l'été dernier, ma fille se passionne pour l'astronomie.
exEn: Since last summer, my daughter has been passionate about astronomy.

mean: to look unwell; to look tired or sick
ex: Tu as mauvaise mine ce matin, tu as bien dormi ?
exEn: You look unwell this morning, did you sleep well?

ex: Au début, mon colocataire était très réservé, puis on est devenus amis.
exEn: At first, my flatmate was very reserved, then we became friends.

mean: to come out of one's shell; to open up
ex: Grâce au théâtre, mon fils est enfin sorti de sa coquille.
exEn: Thanks to drama classes, my son finally came out of his shell.

ex: Pendant son discours, il était si ému qu'il ne trouvait plus ses mots.
exEn: During his speech, he was so moved he couldn't find his words.

mean: to get to know (each other); to meet
ex: On a fait connaissance dans le train pour Lyon.
exEn: We got to know each other on the train to Lyon.

ex: Mes deux meilleures amies ont un point commun : elles adorent danser.
exEn: My two best friends have something in common: they love dancing.

mean: to plan to; to intend to
ex: Ils ont pour projet d'ouvrir un petit café l'année prochaine.
exEn: They're planning to open a little café next year.
